modules.name: shared-types
owns: LeaveType enum (annual | sick | emergency | unpaid | maternity | paternity)
LeaveStatus enum (DRAFT | SUBMITTED | APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED)
AuditAction enum (CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE | APPROVE | REJECT)

modules.name: leave-request
owns: LeaveRequest entity (id, employeeId, leaveType, startDate, endDate, reason, status, approvedBy, approvedAt, createdAt, updatedAt) with lifecycle state machine: DRAFT→SUBMITTED→APPROVED|REJECTED, SUBMITTED→CANCELLED

modules.name: leave-balance
owns: Balance entity (id, employeeId, policyId, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays, fiscalYear, status, createdAt, updatedAt)

modules.name: leave-policy
owns: LeavePolicy entity (id, policyName, leaveType, entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays, requiresManagerApproval, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt)

modules.name: employee
owns: Employee entity (id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId, department, hireDate, terminationDate, employmentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt)

modules.name: audit
owns: AuditRecord entity (id, entityType, entityId, action, oldValues, newValues, performedBy, performedAt, createdAt, updatedAt)

recommended_phases.title: Phase 1: Shared types and foundational modules
recommended_phases.rationale: Establish the shared-types module (LeaveType, LeaveStatus, AuditAction enums) and the employee and audit modules — these have zero internal dependencies and are consumed by everything else. Employee module is needed for identity lookups; audit module is needed for GP-002 compliance on all state-changing operations.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2: Leave policy module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared-types. Provides policy definitions that drive balance initialization and request validation (entitlement days, requiresManagerApproval, minimumNoticeDays). Must exist before balance or request logic can be built.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3: Leave balance module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on shared-types, employee, leave-policy, and audit. Manages balance lifecycle: initialization from policy, deduction on approval, restoration on rejection/cancellation. Must exist before leave-request can perform its state transitions.
